title: RapidCAM Project (.rcam) — version 2
description: Contract for the RapidCAM v2 file format. A .rcam file is JSON describing a design (not an editor session): unlike v1 it carries no selection/UI state, and it may embed the fonts its text entities use. All lengths are in millimetres, in a Y-up world frame, regardless of displayUnit. See docs/rcam-format-v2.md for the authoring guide.

version.description: Format version. Must be exactly 2. The loader upgrades version-1 files automatically.

displayUnit.description: Unit the UI presents values in. Does NOT change the file's units — geometry is always mm.

stockThickness.description: Stock thickness in mm. Default 10 if omitted.

x.description: Lower-left X of the stock within the work area (canvas), mm.

y.description: Lower-left Y of the stock within the work area (canvas), mm.

stockRect.description: Optional positioned flat stock blank within the work area (canvas). Omitted/null = the stock fills the work area (legacy). Ignored for a rotary cylinder.

hasToolChanger.description: Whether the machine has an automatic tool changer (emits T/M6). Default false.

postProcessor.description: Post-processor id. For a mill (machineKind "mill"): "linuxcnc" | "grbl" (default "linuxcnc"). For a laser (machineKind "laser"): a laser controller — "grbl-dynamic" (M4, default), "grbl-constant" (M3), "marlin" (0–255), "smoothie" (inline S 0–1), or "linuxcnc-laser" (PWM spindle). Legacy laser files may store "grbl", which maps to grbl-dynamic.

machineKind.description: Machine the document outputs for. Default "mill" (spindle + Z). "laser" routes export through the fixed-Z beam generator (beam on/off, power + passes, no Z) and the operations use the laser fields (laserPower/laserPasses/kerfWidth/laserFill). "mill-rotary" behaves like "mill" everywhere except export, which wraps the finished flat program around the cylinder described by the top-level "rotary" block (required for this kind) — one work axis stays linear, the wrapped one is emitted as rotary-axis degrees.

endPosition.description: Optional end-of-program park position in work coordinates (mm); the program rapids here at safe Z before M30. { x: 0, y: 0 } parks at the WCS origin. null/omitted leaves the tool where the last toolpath ended.

toolChangePosition.description: Optional park position in work coordinates (mm) the tool rapids to at safe Z before a manual tool change. null/omitted leaves the tool over the work. Ignored with an automatic tool changer and on lasers.

flip.description: Optional double-sided (flip) machining setup. When present, operations carry a "face" and export produces a top-side and a mirrored bottom-side program. null/omitted = single-sided.

rotary.description: Optional cylindrical/rotary wrap setup. When present (mill mode), export rolls the flat program around a cylinder on a 4th axis. null/omitted = flat work.

metadata.description: Optional informational job metadata. Affects no geometry; non-empty fields are written as comments in the G-code header. Omitted when all fields are blank.

features.description: Parametric generator features: geometry produced by a generator that stays re-editable via its parameters. Default [].

layers.description: Layers. If omitted, a single "layer-0" / "Default" layer is created.

activeLayerId.description: Id of the active layer. Default "layer-0".

entities.description: Geometry. May be empty. The reserved origin point "__origin__" is injected automatically and need not be authored.

constraints.description: Parametric constraints. May be empty — geometry is valid without them.

dimensions.description: Dimensions. Driving dimensions also act as constraints. May be empty.

variables.description: Named numeric variables referenced by dimension/pattern/binding expressions.

bindings.description: Headless parametric bindings (formula → an entity scalar DOF). Default [].

tools.description: Tool definitions embedded in the file. Operations reference these by toolId; a single tool can drive many operations. Default [].

fonts.description: Non-bundled fonts referenced by text entities, embedded so glyph outlines — and therefore toolpaths — reproduce on any machine. Bundled fonts (e.g. "roboto-regular") resolve by id and are omitted.

images.description: Greyscale pixels for image entities, embedded so a raster engrave reproduces on any machine.

y.description: mm (Y-up: larger = further from the front)

params.description: Parameter name → value the feature was generated with (its re-run inputs).

groupId.description: Id of the group holding this feature's entities.

offset.description: Translation applied to the generator's origin-based output to place it in the work area; re-applied on regenerate.

fixture.description: When true, closed shapes on this layer are workholding (clamps/fixtures): not machined, and pre-flight flags any move that would hit one.

fixtureHeight.description: Fixture layers only: clamp height above the stock top, mm. A rapid clears the clamp only above this. Omitted = full-height (blocks any pass).

lineEntity.description: Point DOF keys: a, b (endpoints), mid (midpoint, pickable but derived).

circleEntity.description: Point DOF key: c (center). Scalar DOF key: r (radius).

rectangleEntity.description: Axis-aligned. p0/p1 are opposite corners (stored normalised to min/max). Point DOF keys: bl, br, tr, tl (corners); mid_b, mid_r, mid_t, mid_l (edge midpoints); center.

polylineEntity.description: Point DOF keys: v<id> (vertices), mid_<id> (segment midpoints, keyed by the segment's START-vertex id). A segment can substitute for a line in line-type constraints via the entity ref "<polylineId>#<startVertexId>". The id of vertex i is vertexIds[i] when present, else its index as a string ("0","1",…) — so files without vertexIds use v0/mid_0/<id>#0 exactly as before.

vertexIds.description: Optional stable id per vertex, parallel to points (same length). Decouples a vertex's identity from its position so constraints/dimensions survive edits (chamfer/fillet) that insert or remove vertices ahead of them. Omit to default each id to its index as a string.

polygon.description: Present only for a pristine regular polygon: lets editors regenerate it by side count / across-flats Ø. Dropped once a vertex is hand-edited. radius = circumradius (centre→vertex); rotation = angle (rad) of vertex 0.

arcEntity.description: CCW from startAngle to endAngle (radians, world Y-up). Point DOF key: c (center); start/end pickable. Scalar DOF keys: r, sa, ea.

bezierEntity.description: Cubic Bezier. p0=start, p1=start handle, p2=end handle, p3=end. Point DOF keys: p0, p1, p2, p3. Only p0/p3 participate in constraints; p1/p2 are drag-only.

textEntity.description: Editable text, expanded to glyph contours at CAM export. position is the baseline-left anchor. angle is CCW radians. Point DOF key: pos. If fontId is not a bundled font, the font's bytes must appear in the top-level "fonts" array.

fontId.description: e.g. "roboto-regular" (bundled), or a "font-XXXXXXXX" id present in "fonts".

imageEntity.description: A placed raster image for greyscale laser engraving / mill relief carving. position is the bottom-left anchor; the image fills widthMM × heightMM. Point DOF key: pos. The greyscale pixels referenced by imageId must appear in the top-level "images" array. `angle` (CCW radians) rotates the image about its anchor; the engrave/relief sweeps along the image's rotated rows, so a non-zero angle is honoured in both the toolpath and the preview.

imageId.description: Id of the pixels in "images", e.g. "img-1a2b3c4d".

flipX.description: Mirror the image content left↔right. Default false.

flipY.description: Mirror the image content top↔bottom. Default false.

aspectLocked.description: Whether the aspect ratio is locked. Default true. Edit-time only: with it on, editing one of width/height writes a proportional value/formula to the other.

constraintFit.description: How constraints/dimensions may reflow the image; pick the narrowest that matches the intent, since spare freedom lets the solver satisfy a constraint the wrong way. "rigid" (default, omitted): size and rotation are held, so a corner constraint translates the image. "scale": the size may change uniformly (aspect exact — width and height are one degree of freedom) while the rotation is held, e.g. dimension a known distance on a scan to calibrate it. "rotate": rotation only, size held (level a tilted scan). "scale-rotate": both, a similarity fit for the exactly-determined case of pinning two corners. "stretch": width, height and angle are all free (non-uniform fit).

embeddedFont.description: A font embedded in the file, referenced by textEntity.fontId.

format.description: Container format of the embedded bytes.

embeddedImage.description: A raster image embedded in the file, referenced by imageEntity.imageId. Stored as a downscaled GREYSCALE buffer (one byte per pixel, row-major, row 0 = top, 0 = black) — colour carries no machining information for a laser.

width.description: Pixel width of the greyscale buffer.

height.description: Pixel height of the greyscale buffer.

pointRef.description: A reference to one named point DOF inside an entity. See each entity's DOF-key list.

points.description: Point operands. Count/role depends on type (see docs). Optional — defaults to [] when the type uses only entities.

entities.description: Entity operands (entity ids, or polyline-segment refs "<id>#<index>"). Count/role depends on type. Optional — defaults to [] when the type uses only points.

params.description: Type-specific numbers: angle→[radians]; fixedPoint→[x, y]; center→optional [axis] (0=X-only, 1=Y-only; omit for both).

points.description: Linear dims: the 2 measured points. Optional — defaults to [] for entity-based dims (radius/diameter/arclength/circle-gap).

entities.description: radius/diameter/arclength: 1 circle or arc id. angle/line-distance: 2 line ids. circle-gap: 2 circle/arc ids (the boundary-to-boundary distance, e.g. an inner/outer offset). Optional — defaults to [] for point-based dims.

driving.description: When true, also constrains the measurement to value.

offset.description: Placement of the dimension line/leader. Visual only.

anchors.description: [t1, t2] parametric anchors for line-distance extension lines.

hidden.description: Not drawn. A hidden driving dimension is how a formula typed into a measurement property field (line length, rect W/H) parks in the engine — it drives geometry but shows no annotation.

expr.description: Raw input string, e.g. "100", "50mm", "3.5in", or a formula referencing other variables like "width * 0.1" (evaluated in dependency order).

scalarBinding.description: Headless parametric binding: drives one scalar DOF of an entity (by its dofScalars key, e.g. "r" for a circle radius) from a variable formula. Draws nothing; contributes a driving residual (currentScalar − expr) to the solver, so it reconciles with dimensions/constraints via the same over-constrained machinery.

scalarKey.description: A dofScalars() key on the entity, e.g. "r" (circle/arc radius), "sa"/"ea" (arc angles), "w"/"h"/"angle" (image width/height/rotation).

scale.description: Multiplier from the formula's display unit to the scalar's internal unit. Omitted/1 for lengths (mm); π/180 for an angle scalar (sa/ea, or image angle) entered in degrees.

instanceIds.description: One sub-array per generated step, listing that step's copy entity ids. Those entities must also exist in `entities`.

sourceSnapshot.description: FNV-32 hash of source geometry; staleness check. Optional.

countXExpr.description: Optional variable expression driving countX, e.g. "tabs" or "n + 1"; re-evaluated against variables, rounded, clamped ≥1.

countExpr.description: Optional variable expression driving count; re-evaluated against variables, rounded, clamped ≥2.

strategy.description: How tab quantity is set: "count" (default) places `count` tabs evenly; "spacing" places one roughly every `spacing` mm of perimeter (a longer contour gets more).

count.description: Number of tabs, evenly distributed ("count" strategy).

height.description: material left standing above the floor, mm

regionRef.description: A pocket target region, identified by the loops that enclose it (each loop = the entity ids whose geometry forms it). Resolved against live geometry at toolpath time so it survives constraint-driven reflow.

containingLoops.description: Entity-id sets of the loops enclosing the region; one inner array per loop. The face lies inside exactly these loops and outside all others.

flip.description: Double-sided machining setup. Operations carry a "face"; the top ops cut as drawn, then the stock is flipped and the bottom ops cut from a program mirrored about the flip axis. Mill-only.

axis.description: The mirror the flip performs. "h" = flip left ↔ right (mirror X about the stock's vertical centreline); "v" = flip near ↔ far (mirror Y about the horizontal centreline).

registration.description: How the flipped stock is realigned. "pins" bores dowel holes through the stock into the spoilboard at the end of the top-side program; "none" leaves it to the operator (e.g. a fixed fence).

pinDepth.description: How far past the stock bottom the pin holes bore into the spoilboard, mm.

pins.description: Registration hole centres, in world/canvas mm. Must be invariant under the mirror for the flip to align (each pin has a mirror-image partner or sits on the flip-axis centreline).

rotary.description: Cylindrical/rotary wrap setup. Export rolls the flat program around a cylinder on a 4th axis: one work axis stays linear (cylinder length), the perpendicular one is emitted as a rotary word in degrees. Mill-only; not combinable with flip.

axisWord.description: Rotary axis word for the wrapped coordinate. "A" (about machine X) pairs with wrapAxis "y"; "B" (about Y) pairs with "x".

diameter.description: Cylinder stock diameter, mm. 360° of rotation = π·diameter of surface travel.

wrapAxis.description: Which work axis rolls around the cylinder. "y" (default): Y wraps to rotation, X runs along the length. "x": swapped.

zero.description: Where Z0 sits. "surface" (default): Z0 = top of the cylinder surface, cuts negative; gSender needs its "Visualize non-center zeros" toggle to visualize it. "center": Z0 = rotary axis (centreline), surface at Z = radius — the native rotary convention gSender visualizes with no toggle. Omitted = "surface".

arcTolerance.description: Chord tolerance (mm) for flattening arcs into the wrap. Default 0.1.

side.description: Which side of the contour the cut runs on. Required for "profile" (and drives laser kerf offset); ignored — and may be omitted — for every other type.

followPattern.description: When the op's geometry belongs to a pattern, the toolpath covers the whole pattern and follows its count. Set false to cut only the literal entityIds. Default (omitted) = follow.

face.description: Double-sided machining: which face of the stock this op cuts. "bottom" ops are machined after the stock is flipped, with geometry mirrored about the flip axis. Absent/"top" = the first setup, cut as drawn. Ignored unless the document has "flip" set.

toolId.description: Optional reference to a tool id in the top-level "tools" array. When it resolves, that tool's geometry/feeds override the inline toolType/diameter/vAngle/tipAngle/feedrate/plungeRate/spindleSpeed/safeZ fields below (which remain as a fallback). toolNumber and the cut settings (depth/stepdown/stepover) always stay per-operation.

depth.description: mm below surface; NEGATIVE for cuts.

stepdown.description: mm per depth pass (ignored for drill). Optional; defaults to 1.5 when omitted.

peckDepth.description: Drill only: peck increment (mm). Drills the hole in steps, fully retracting between pecks (G83-style). Omitted/0 = single full-depth plunge.

finishPass.description: Profile/pocket: leave a thin radial skin during roughing and remove it in a final full-depth wall pass, cleaning the ridges between depth levels. Default false.

rampAngle.description: Entry ramp angle (degrees off horizontal) for ops that descend gradually (pocket helix/linear entry, relief-rough ramp). Overrides each mechanism's built-in default; clamped 0.5–45°. Omitted = the default.

cutDirection.description: Profile only: cut direction relative to an M3 (CW) spindle. "climb" (CW outside / CCW inside) finishes cleanly on rigid machines; "conventional" is the reverse. Omitted = leave the raw offset winding untouched.

cornerStyle.description: Corner relief. "dogbone" adds a diagonal overcut at each concave corner so a mating square part seats. "tbone" adds a parallel overcut extending the longer wall. Default "none".

finishAllowance.description: Stock (mm) left for a finishing pass. For profile/pocket: radial wall stock left during roughing, used only when finishPass is true (clamped below the tool radius). For relief-rough: the depth of material left above the final relief surface for the ball-nose finish pass to remove. Default 0.2.

chamferWidth.description: Chamfer only: horizontal width (mm) of the bevel face. The plunge depth is derived from this and the V-bit angle (depth = width / tan(½·vAngle)). Requires a v-bit tool.

chamferSide.description: Chamfer only: which side of the contour the bevel sits on ("on" = centred on the edge). Default "on".

sharpenCorners.description: Chamfer only: pull the V-bit tip up into each sharp inside (convex) corner — the bevel tapers to the surface at the corner vertex — so corners come to a crisp point instead of a rounded fillet. Concave corners are left rounded (a V-bit can't reach them). Default false.

vStep.description: V-carve only: radial inset (mm) between offset-peel passes — the pitch that sets floor smoothness. Requires a v-bit tool; uses vAngle for the slope and |depth| as the max (floor) depth. Default 0.4.

vHopClearance.description: V-carve only: clearance height (mm above the stock surface) for rapid hops between a region's contours. > 0 hops at this low height instead of retracting to safeZ between every peel ring (less air time). Omitted/0 = retract to safeZ — the safe default, since a low hop does not clear a clamp/fixture standing above the stock within the carve footprint.

coolant.description: Coolant for this operation: "mist" → M7, "flood" → M8 (M9 off). Default "off". Only emitted if the machine is flagged as having coolant (a machine-wide app preference).

stepover.description: fraction of tool diameter (pocket/clearing). Optional; defaults to 0.4 when omitted.

islandIds.description: Pocket only (legacy): entities treated as islands.

regions.description: Pocket only: the enclosed regions to clear, identified parametrically (by the loops that enclose each) so they reflow with the model. Resolved against live geometry at toolpath time. Supersedes the older absolute-coordinate seeds.

laserPower.description: Laser only (machineKind "laser"): beam power as a percentage (0–100) of the controller's max (GRBL $30), scaled to an S word. Default 80.

laserPasses.description: Laser only: number of times the beam re-traces each path (the fixed-Z analogue of milling stepdown). Default 1.

kerfWidth.description: Laser profile only: beam kerf width (mm). Closed profiles are offset by half this — outward for side "outside", inward for "inside". 0 = cut on the line. Engrave ignores it.

laserFill.description: Laser engrave only: flood the interior of closed shapes with parallel scan lines (area/solid engraving) in addition to outlining them. Closed contours are grouped even–odd so letter counters stay unfilled. Default false.

laserFillSpacing.description: Laser fill only: spacing (mm) between scan lines — roughly the beam/line width. Default 0.2.

laserOverscan.description: Laser fill / raster only: overscan distance (mm) the head runs past each scan line's/row's ends with the beam off, so it's at full speed when the beam fires (avoids over-burned edges). 0 = off. Default 0.

airAssist.description: Laser only: enable air assist for this operation (the post's air command, M8/M9 by default), kept on across consecutive ops that request it and off otherwise. Default false.

rasterLineInterval.description: Image-engrave only (an Engrave op targeting an image entity — a LASER raster or a MILL relief): vertical pitch (mm) between scan rows (the line interval for a laser, the stepover for a mill). Laser default 0.1; mill relief default 0.3.

rasterDotPitch.description: Image-engrave only: horizontal pitch (mm) between dots within a row. Omitted = square dots (uses rasterLineInterval).

rasterMinPower.description: Laser raster engrave only: beam power (%) for the lightest engraved dot (laserPower is the power for a fully black dot). Default 0.

rasterInvert.description: Image-engrave / relief-rough only: engrave/carve the light areas instead of the dark (negative). Default false. Should match between a relief roughing op and its finish op.

rasterDither.description: Laser raster engrave only: reproduce tone as a 1-bit dot pattern instead of per-dot power modulation. Every fired dot burns at laserPower and tone comes from dot density; rasterMinPower is then unused. floyd-steinberg/atkinson/jarvis are error-diffusion kernels (FS = classic, Jarvis = smoother/wider, Atkinson = higher contrast); ordered = 8x8 Bayer pattern. Omitted or 'none' = greyscale power (default).

reliefGamma.description: Mill relief only (engrave-on-image or relief-rough): tone curve on carved depth — depth proportional to darkness^gamma. 1 = linear (default). >1 lifts the mid-tones (flatter, shallower background), <1 deepens them. Black/white endpoints are fixed. Should match between a relief roughing op and its finish op.

tool.description: A reusable tool definition referenced by operations via toolId.

id.description: Unique tool id; the target of operation.toolId.
